en.title: A Family Reunion Supporting Emotional Recovery
en.excerpt: Cambridge Hospital Abu Dhabi arranged a surprise reunion for a patient following his successful weaning from mechanical ventilation. His mother, wife, children...
en.body: Cambridge Hospital Abu Dhabi arranged a surprise reunion for a patient following his successful weaning from mechanical ventilation. His mother, wife, children and brother travelled from abroad to share the moment, reflecting the hospital’s commitment to supporting emotional well-being alongside clinical progress and physical rehabilitation.

ar.body: نظم مستشفى كامبريدج أبوظبي لقاء مفاجئ لمريض بعد فطامه الناجح من التنفس الميكانيكي. سافرت والدته وزوجته وأطفاله وأخوه من الخارج لمشاركة اللحظة، مما يعكس التزام المستشفى بدعم الصحة النفسية إلى جانب التقدم السريري والتأهيل البدني.
